en.s: The Battle of Qianshi (Chinese: 乾時之戰) was a military conflict between the armies of Qi and Lu that occurred in 685 BCE when Duke Zhuang of Lu invaded Qi over a succession dispute.

en.s: The Treaty of Mersen or Meerssen, concluded on 8 August 870, was a treaty to partition the realm of Lothair II, known as Lotharingia, by his uncles Louis the German of East Francia and Charles the Bald of West Francia, the two surviving sons of Emperor Louis I the Pious. The treaty followed an earlier Treaty of Prüm which had split Middle Francia between Lothair I's sons after his death in 855.

zh.s: 《梅尔森条约》又称《默尔森条约》，于870年8月8日缔结。东法兰克国王日耳曼人路易和西法兰克国王秃头查理——虔诚者路易的两位在世儿子——将其侄子洛泰尔二世的王国洛塔林吉亚一分为二。此前，洛泰尔一世于855年去世后，其儿子们曾通过《普吕姆条约》瓜分中法兰克王国。

en.s: The Battle of Lihula or Battle of Leal was fought between invading Swedes and Estonians for the control of a castle in Lihula, Estonia in 1220. The exact date remains uncertain, though some historians suggest that the battle took place on August 8. The event is described in the Chronicle of Henry of Livonia and the Livonian Rhymed Chronicle.

zh.s: 利胡拉战役又称利尔战役，是1220年入侵的瑞典军队与爱沙尼亚人之间为争夺爱沙尼亚利胡拉城堡控制权而发生的战斗。确切日期尚不确定，不过一些历史学家认为战斗发生在8月8日。事件见于《亨利·利沃尼亚编年史》和《利沃尼亚韵文编年史》。

en.s: The siege of Ypres occurred between 8 June and 8 August 1383 as part of Despenser's Crusade and the Revolt of Ghent (1379–1385). It was conducted by English forces and forces from the Flemish city of Ghent. The siege was a failure.

zh.s: 伊普尔围城战发生于1383年6月8日至8月8日，是德斯潘塞十字军东征和根特起义（1379–1385年）的一部分。围城部队由英格兰军队和佛兰德斯城市根特的军队组成，但围城以失败告终。

en.s: The Jingnan campaign, or the campaign to clear away disorders, was a three-year civil war from 1399 to 1402 in the early years of the Ming dynasty of China between the Jianwen Emperor and his uncle, Zhu Di, Prince of Yan. The war was sparked by the removal of the Emperor's uncles and the restriction of Zhu Di's power by the central government after the Jianwen Emperor ascended to the throne in 1398.

en.s: The Battle of Dungan's Hill took place in County Meath, in eastern Ireland on 8 August 1647. It was fought between the armies of Confederate Ireland and the English Parliament during the Irish Confederate Wars. The Irish army was intercepted on a march towards Dublin and destroyed. Although it is a little-known event, even in Ireland, the battle was very bloody (with over 3000 deaths) and had important political repercussions.

zh.s: 邓甘斯山战役于1647年8月8日在爱尔兰东部米斯郡发生。交战双方是爱尔兰邦联军和英格兰议会军，属于爱尔兰邦联战争的一部分。爱尔兰军队在向都柏林行军途中遭拦截并被歼灭。这场战役即使在爱尔兰也鲜为人知，但十分惨烈，造成3000多人死亡，并产生了重要的政治影响。

en.s: The Battle of Vilnius was an attack by Russian and Cossack forces on Vilnius, the capital of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania within the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, that occurred on 8 August 1655 during the Russo-Polish War (1654–67). The Polish–Lithuanian forces under the leadership of Grand Hetman of Lithuania Janusz Radziwiłł were defeated by the Russian army of Alexis of Russia.

zh.s: 维尔纽斯战役发生于1655年8月8日，是俄波战争（1654–1667年）期间俄罗斯和哥萨克军队对维尔纽斯发动的一次进攻。当时维尔纽斯是波兰立陶宛联邦境内立陶宛大公国的首都。立陶宛大盖特曼雅努什·拉齐维乌率领的波兰立陶宛军队被俄罗斯沙皇阿列克谢一世的军队击败。

en.s: Battle of Rügen was a major naval battle fought on August 8, 1715 off Jasmund on the Swedish island of Rügen (present-day Germany) during the Great Northern War. In the Swedish navy 20 ships of the line and two frigates participated, in the Danish 21 ships of the line and four frigates. The battle ended with a Danish strategic victory but was tactically inconclusive.

zh.s: 吕根岛海战是一次重要海战，于1715年8月8日在瑞典吕根岛（今属德国）雅斯蒙德附近爆发，属于大北方战争的一部分。瑞典海军出动20艘战列舰和2艘护卫舰，丹麦海军则出动21艘战列舰和4艘护卫舰。战斗以丹麦取得战略胜利告终，但战术上未分胜负。

en.s: The Russo-Swedish War of 1741–1743 (also known as The War of the Hats or The Hats' war) was instigated by the Hats, a Swedish political party that aspired to regain the territories lost to Russia during the Great Northern War, and by French diplomacy, which sought to divert Russia's attention from supporting its long-standing ally the Habsburg monarchy in the War of the Austrian Succession.

en.s: The Battle of Piqua, also known as the Battle of Pekowee or Pekowi, was part of the western campaign during the American Revolutionary War. Led by General George Rogers Clark, over 1,000 soldiers (among them Daniel Boone and Simon Kenton) crossed the Ohio River near present-day Cincinnati and burned five Shawnee villages, including Old Chillicothe, along the Little Miami River. Peter Loramie's Store, a British trading post-located in what was later Fort Loramie, Ohio in Shelby County, Ohio-, was also burned by Clark's men. The Shawnee gradually withdrew during the first few days before finally engaging American forces 7 miles west of Springfield, Ohio on August 8, 1780.

zh.s: 皮夸战役又称佩科威战役，是美国独立战争西部战场的一部分。乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克将军率领1000多名士兵（其中包括丹尼尔·布恩和西蒙·肯顿）渡过俄亥俄河，在今辛辛那提附近上岸，沿小迈阿密河焚毁了五个肖尼村庄，包括老奇利科西。克拉克的部队还烧毁了彼得·洛拉米商店——英国人设在俄亥俄州谢尔比县、后来成为洛拉米堡所在地的一处贸易站。肖尼人最初几天逐渐撤退，随后于1780年8月8日在俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德以西7英里处与美军交战。

en.s: The Hudson Bay expedition was a series of military raids on the fur trading outposts and fortifications of the British Hudson's Bay Company (HBC) on the shores of Hudson Bay by a French Navy squadron under the command of the Comte de Lapérouse. Setting sail from Cap-Français, Saint-Domingue in 1782, the expedition was part of a series of globe-spanning naval conflicts between France and Great Britain during the American Revolutionary War.

zh.s: 哈德逊湾远征是1782年法国海军中队在拉彼鲁兹伯爵指挥下，对英国哈德逊湾公司（HBC）位于哈德逊湾沿岸的毛皮贸易据点和防御工事实施的一系列军事袭击。远征队从圣多明各的法兰西角启航，属于美国独立战争期间法国与英国一系列横跨全球的海战冲突。

en.s: The Bombardment of Algiers in August 1783 was a failed attempt by Spain to put an end to Algerine privateering against Spanish shipping. A Spanish fleet of 70, sailing under Rear Admiral Antonio Barceló, bombarded the city eight times between August 4–8 but inflicted only minor damages to the Algerine military. Both Spaniards and Algerines fought poorly, but Barceló, blaming unfavorable weather conditions, gave the order to withdraw.

zh.s: 1783年8月，西班牙试图通过炮击阿尔及尔，阻止阿尔及尔私掠船袭击西班牙船只，但未能成功。安东尼奥·巴塞洛海军少将率领70艘舰船，于8月4日至8日八次炮击该城，却只对阿尔及尔军队造成轻微损失。西班牙和阿尔及尔双方的作战表现都不佳。巴塞洛将撤退归咎于天气不利，并下令撤军。

en.s: The Battle of Caesar's Camp (7–8 August 1793) saw the Coalition army led by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld try to envelop a Republican French army under Charles Edward Jennings de Kilmaine. Numerically superior Habsburg Austrian, British and Hanoverian columns converged on the fortified French camp, but Kilmaine wisely decided to slip away toward Arras.

zh.s: 凯撒营战役于1793年8月7日至8日爆发。约西亚斯·冯·萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德亲王率领联军，试图包围查尔斯·爱德华·詹宁斯·德基尔梅因指挥的法兰西共和军。兵力占优的哈布斯堡奥地利、英国和汉诺威军队纵队向法军坚固营地汇合，但基尔梅因明智地决定撤往阿拉斯。

en.s: The Battle of Arzobispo on 8 August 1809 saw two Imperial French corps commanded by Marshal Nicolas Soult launch an assault crossing of the Tagus River against a Spanish force under José María de la Cueva, 14th Duke of Albuquerque. Albuquerque's troops rapidly retreated after suffering disproportionate losses, including 30 artillery pieces. El Puente del Arzobispo (The Archbishop's Bridge) is located 36 kilometres (22 mi) southwest of Talavera de la Reina, Spain. The action occurred during the Peninsular War, part of a larger conflict known as the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1809年8月8日，尼古拉·苏尔特元帅指挥的两支法兰西帝国军团强行渡过塔霍河，进攻何塞·玛丽亚·德·拉·库埃瓦率领的西班牙军队。西班牙军队损失惨重，包括30门火炮，随后迅速撤退。阿索比斯波桥（El Puente del Arzobispo）位于西班牙塔拉韦拉-德拉雷纳西南36公里处。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间；半岛战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The Treaty of Wapakoneta was signed on August 8, 1831. Remnants of the Shawnee Native American tribe in Wapakoneta were forced to relinquish claims that they had to land in western Ohio. In exchange, the United States government agreed to provide the tribe with 100,000 acres (400 km²) of land west of the Mississippi River. The United States officials agreed to provide supplies and monetary payment and to construct a sawmill and a gristmill for the Shawnees on their newly allocated land. This agreement became known as the Treaty of Wapakoneta or the Treaty with the Shawnee.

zh.s: 瓦帕科内塔条约于1831年8月8日签署。居住在瓦帕科内塔的肖尼族原住民残部被迫放弃对俄亥俄州西部土地的所有权主张。作为交换，美国政府同意在密西西比河以西划拨10万英亩（400平方公里）土地给肖尼族。美国官员还同意提供物资和金钱补偿，并在新划拨的土地上为肖尼族修建锯木厂和谷物磨坊。这项协议称为瓦帕科内塔条约或《与肖尼族条约》。

en.t: Battle of San Felipe del Obraje
en.s: the Battle of San Felipe del Obraje took place on August 8, 1861 in Loma de Jalpa near the town of San Felipe del Obraje in the State of Mexico, Mexico, between elements of the liberal army, under the command of Gen. Jesus Gonzalez Ortega and elements of the conservative army during War of the Reformation. Although technically the war had ended with the victory of the Liberals and the entry of Benito Juarez to the capital, conservatives were trying to form strength to somehow beat the Liberals. The victory corresponded to the liberal side, so that conservatives were dispersed in Xalatlaco.

zh.t: 圣费利佩德尔奥布拉赫战役
zh.s: 圣费利佩德尔奥布拉赫战役于1861年8月8日在墨西哥州圣费利佩德尔奥布拉赫镇附近的哈尔帕山发生，交战双方是改革战争期间耶稣·冈萨雷斯·奥尔特加将军指挥的自由派军队和保守派军队。虽然战争在法律上已因自由派胜利、贝尼托·华雷斯进入首都而结束，保守派仍试图重新集结力量，以击败自由派。自由派赢得这场战斗，保守派随后在哈拉特拉科溃散。

en.s: The Battle of Żyrzyn took place on August 8, 1863 in or near the village of Żyrzyn, Puławy County, Poland, between a small detachment of Russian troops and a force of Polish troops under the command of General Michal Heidenreich. The Russian force of 500 soldiers and two cannon were escorting a load of 200,000 rubles for the Russian army, 140,000 of which was captured by the Polish forces, along with 282 prisoners of war. Of the remaining Russian troops, 181 were killed, and 87 men escaped along with the remaining 60,000 rubles.

zh.s: 日尔任战役于1863年8月8日在波兰普瓦维县日尔任村或其附近发生，交战双方是俄罗斯小股部队和米哈乌·海登赖希将军指挥的波兰军队。500名俄罗斯士兵和两门火炮押运20万卢布，波兰军队缴获其中14万卢布，并俘虏282人。其余俄罗斯士兵中，181人阵亡，87人带着剩下的6万卢布逃脱。

en.s: The siege of Bitche was a battle during the Franco-Prussian War initially caused by the German forces on August 8, 1870, to March 26, 1871, where the two nations would sign an armistice. The siege was considered a brave siege under the command of governor Louis-Casimir Teyssier, and of the chief of the troops of the place: Geniès-Hippolyte Bousquet who both would be appointed lieutenant-colonels during the siege.

zh.s: 比奇围城战是普法战争期间的一场战役。德军于1870年8月8日发起进攻，围城持续至1871年3月26日，两国随后签署停战协定。守军总督路易·卡西米尔·泰西耶和当地部队首领热涅斯-伊波利特·布斯凯在围城期间都被任命为中校。

en.t: Assassination of Antonio Cánovas del Castillo
en.s: Italian anarchist Michele Angiolillo assassinated Spanish Prime Minister Antonio Cánovas del Castillo on 8 August 1897, in Gipuzkoa. The head of government had been vacationing in the Santa Águeda spa. The assassin was immediately arrested, tried, and executed. He justified the murder as revenge for torture during the Montjuïc trial.

zh.s: 1897年8月8日，意大利无政府主义者米凯莱·安焦利洛在吉普斯夸刺杀了西班牙首相安东尼奥·卡诺瓦斯·德尔卡斯蒂略。当时首相正在圣阿格达温泉疗养。刺客当场被捕，随后受审并被处决。他以报复蒙锥克审判期间遭受的酷刑为由，解释这次刺杀。

en.s: The Raid on the Norias Division of the King Ranch was an attack August 8, 1915 by a large band of disaffected Mexicans and Tejanos in southern Texas. It was one of the many small battles of the Mexican Revolution that spilled over into United States soil and resulted in an increased effort by the United States Army to defend the international border.

zh.s: 诺里亚斯牧场分区遭袭发生于1915年8月8日。大批不满现状的墨西哥人和德克萨斯裔墨西哥人袭击了得克萨斯州南部的牧场。它是墨西哥革命期间蔓延至美国境内的多起小规模战斗之一，并促使美国陆军加强对国际边境的防卫。

en.s: The Battle of Kowel (also known as the Battle of Kovel or the Battle of Kovel-Stanislav) took place during World War I, from 28 July to 8 August 1916. It began with an Austrian counter-attack by Alexander von Linsingen south of Kowel, a city located in the Volyn Oblast (province), in north-western Ukraine. Linsingen intended to halt the Russian offensive under the command of General Aleksei Alekseevich Brusilov.

zh.s: 科韦利战役又称科韦尔战役或科韦尔—斯坦尼斯拉夫战役，于第一次世界大战期间的1916年7月28日至8月8日进行。战役始于亚历山大·冯·林辛根在科韦利以南发动的奥地利反击。科韦利位于乌克兰西北部沃伦州。林辛根意在阻止阿列克谢·阿列克谢耶维奇·布鲁西洛夫将军指挥的俄军攻势。

en.s: The Battle of Amiens, also known as the Third Battle of Picardy (French: 3ème Bataille de Picardie), which began on 8 August 1918, was the opening phase of the Allied offensive later known as the Hundred Days Offensive that ultimately led to the end of the First World War. Allied forces advanced over 11 kilometres (7 mi) on the first day, one of the greatest advances of the war, with Henry Rawlinson's British Fourth Army playing the decisive role. The battle is also notable for its effects on both sides' morale and the large number of surrendering German forces.

zh.s: 亚眠战役又称第三次皮卡第战役（法语：3ème Bataille de Picardie），于1918年8月8日打响，是后来被称为“百日攻势”的盟军攻势的开端，最终推动第一次世界大战结束。盟军首日推进超过11公里（7英里），这是战争中最远距离的推进之一；亨利·罗林森指挥的英国第四集团军发挥了决定性作用。这场战役还显著影响了交战双方的士气，并导致大量德国军队投降。

en.s: The Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919, also known as the Treaty of Rawalpindi, was a bilateral treaty which brought the Third Anglo-Afghan War to an end.This is regarded as the largest peace treaty since the Treaty of Versailles, which was enacted in the same year.
en.n: The Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919 is signed. It establishes peaceful relations between Afghanistan and the UK, and confirms the Durand line as the mutual border. In return, the UK is no longer obligated to subsidize the Afghan government.

zh.s: 1919年英阿条约又称《拉瓦尔品第条约》，是一项结束第三次英阿战争的双边条约。它被认为是自同年签订的《凡尔赛条约》以来规模最大的和平条约。
zh.n: 《1919年英阿条约》签署，确立阿富汗与英国的和平关系，并确认杜兰线为双方共同边界。作为交换，英国不再有义务补贴阿富汗政府。

en.s: The Third Anglo-Afghan War, also known as the Third Afghan War, the British-Afghan War of 1919, and in Afghanistan as the War of Liberation, was a short war which began on 3 May and ended on 8 August 1919. The new Emir of the Emirate of Afghanistan Amanullah Khan declared the holy war of Jihad against the British in the hope to proclaim full independence, as well as to strengthen his own legitimacy.

zh.s: 第三次英阿战争又称第三次阿富汗战争、1919年英阿战争，在阿富汗也称为解放战争。这场短暂战争于1919年5月3日开始，并于8月8日结束。阿富汗埃米尔国的新任埃米尔阿曼努拉·汗宣布对英国发动圣战，希望宣布阿富汗完全独立，并巩固自己的合法性。

en.s: Peru v Austria was a football match played on 8 August 1936 during the Summer Olympics at Hertha Platz in Berlin. The match became notable for causing controversy after it was annulled because of a pitch invasion from Peruvian supporters who had assaulted the Austrian players. Peru had three extra time goals disallowed by the referee and ended up winning the match 4–2.

zh.s: 秘鲁对奥地利足球赛于1936年8月8日在柏林赫塔广场举行，是夏季奥运会期间的一场比赛。秘鲁球迷冲入球场并袭击奥地利球员，比赛因此被判作废，引发争议。裁判判秘鲁队三个加时赛进球无效，秘鲁队最终以4比2获胜。

en.s: Operation Chahar (Japanese: チャハル作戦, romanized: Chaharu Sakusen), known in Chinese as the Nankou Campaign (Chinese: 南口戰役; pinyin: Nankou Zhanyi), occurred in August 1937, following the Battle of Beiping-Tianjin at the beginning of Second Sino-Japanese War. This was the second attack by the Kwantung Army and the Inner Mongolian Army of Prince Demchugdongrub on Inner Mongolia after the failure of the Suiyuan Campaign.

zh.s: 察哈尔作战（日语：チャハル作戦，转写：Chaharu Sakusen），中文称南口战役（中文：南口戰役；拼音：Nankou Zhanyi），发生于1937年8月，是第二次中日战争初期平津作战之后的战事。这是关东军与德穆楚克栋鲁普亲王的内蒙古军第二次进攻内蒙古；此前他们在绥远战役中失利。

en.s: The Battle of Uman (15 July – 8 August 1941) was the World War II German offensive in Uman, Ukraine against the 6th and 12th Soviet Armies. In a three-week period, the Wehrmacht encircled and annihilated the two Soviet armies. The battle occurred during the Kiev defensive operation between the elements of the Red Army's Southwestern Front, retreating from the Lwow salient, and German Army Group South, commanded by Field Marshal Gerd von Rundstedt, as part of Operation Barbarossa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乌曼战役于1941年7月15日至8月8日进行，是第二次世界大战期间德国军队在乌克兰乌曼地区对苏联第六和第十二集团军发动的攻势。三个星期内，德国国防军包围并歼灭了这两支苏军。战役发生在基辅防御战期间，交战双方是从利沃夫突出部撤退的红军西南方面军部队，以及由格尔德·冯·伦德施泰特元帅指挥的德国南方集团军群；战役属于巴巴罗萨行动的一部分。

en.s: Convoy ON 115 was a trade convoy of 43 merchant ships with 12 escort ships during the Second World War. The convoy departed Liverpool on 24 July 1942 and arrived at Boston on 8 August. Three ships were lost to U-boats during the crossing and two were damaged.

en.t: Quit India Movement is launched in India against the British rule in response to Mohandas Gandhi's call for swaraj or complete independence
en.s: The Quit India Movement was a political campaign launched at the Bombay session of the All India Congress Committee by Mahatma Gandhi on 8 August 1942, during World War II, demanding an end to British rule in India. After Britain failed to secure Indian support for the British war effort with the Cripps Mission, Gandhi made a call to Do or Die in his Quit India speech delivered in Bombay on 8 August 1942 at the Gowalia Tank Maidan.

zh.t: 印度退出运动发起，响应甘地的呼吁，反对英国统治并争取自治或完全独立
zh.s: 印度退出运动是圣雄甘地于1942年8月8日在孟买举行的全印度国大委员会会议上发起的一场政治运动，要求结束英国对印度的统治。当时正值第二次世界大战期间，英国未能通过克里普斯使团争取到印度支持其战时行动。甘地随后在1942年8月8日于孟买戈瓦利亚坦克广场发表“要么行动，要么牺牲”（Do or Die）的退出运动演讲。

en.t: Mahatma Gandhi delivers the Quit India speech
en.s: The Quit India speech (Hindustani: भारत छोड़ो भाषण, بھارت چھوڑو تقریر) was given by Mahatma Gandhi on the eve of the Quit India Movement, 8 August 1942. His address was issued shortly before midnight, at the Gowalia Tank Maidan park in Bombay (present-day Mumbai), which has since been renamed August Kranti Maidan (August Revolution Ground).

zh.t: 圣雄甘地发表《退出印度演说》
zh.s: 《退出印度演说》（印度斯坦语：भारत छोड़ो भाषण；بھارت چھوڑو تقریر）是圣雄甘地于1942年8月8日、退出印度运动前夕发表的演讲。他在午夜前不久于孟买的戈瓦利亚坦克广场公园发表演说。该公园现已更名为“八月革命广场”（August Kranti Maidan）。

en.s: The 1944 Alberta general election was held on August 8, 1944, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. As well, in late 1944 and early 1945, Albertans serving in the military voted for separate representation - by electing an Army, an Air Force and a Navy representative (see "Soldiers' vote" below). The election was the first contested by leader Ernest C. Manning.

zh.s: 1944年艾伯塔省大选于1944年8月8日举行，选出艾伯塔省议会议员。此外，1944年末至1945年初，在军队服役的艾伯塔省居民另行投票，选出代表陆军、空军和海军的议员（见“军人投票”部分）。这是欧内斯特·C·曼宁担任党领袖后首次参加的选举。

en.s: The 1944 Quebec general election was held on August 8, 1944 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The Union Nationale, led by former premier Maurice Duplessis, defeated the incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Adélard Godbout. This was the first Quebec provincial election in which women were allowed to vote, having been granted suffrage at the provincial level in 1941 (much later than what had been fully attained at the federal level in 1919).

zh.s: 1944年魁北克省大选于1944年8月8日举行，选出加拿大魁北克省议会议员。前省长莫里斯·杜普莱西领导的民族联盟击败了阿德拉尔·戈德布领导的执政魁北克自由党。这是魁北克省首次允许女性参加投票的省级选举；女性于1941年获得省级选举权，比她们在联邦层面全面获得选举权的1919年晚得多。

en.s: The Soviet–Japanese War was a campaign of the Second World War that began with the Soviet invasion of Manchuria following the Soviet declaration of war against Japan on 8 August 1945. The Soviet Union and Mongolian People's Republic toppled the Japanese puppet states of Manchukuo in Manchuria and Mengjiang in Inner Mongolia, as well as northern Korea, Karafuto on the island of Sakhalin, and the Kuril Islands. The defeat of Japan's Kwantung Army helped bring about the Japanese surrender and the end of World War II.

zh.s: 苏日战争是第二次世界大战期间的一场战役，始于苏联于1945年8月8日对日宣战后入侵满洲。苏联和蒙古人民共和国推翻了日本在满洲建立的伪满洲国、在内蒙古建立的蒙疆，以及朝鲜北部、萨哈林岛上的南桦太厅和千岛群岛的统治。日本关东军战败，促使日本投降并推动第二次世界大战结束。

en.t: First flight of the nuclear capable Convair B-36, heaviest mass-produced piston-engined aircraft at the time
en.s: The Convair B-36 "Peacemaker" was a piston-engined, strategic bomber built by Convair and operated by the United States Air Force's Strategic Air Command from 1948 to 1959. With 384 units built, the B-36 remains the largest mass-produced, piston-engined aircraft and has the longest wingspan of any combat aircraft. The B-36 was capable of intercontinental flight without refueling. The B-36 was powered by six Pratt & Whitney R-4360 Wasp Major radial piston engines.

zh.t: 具备核打击能力的康维尔B-36轰炸机首飞；它当时是量产活塞式飞机中最重的一款
zh.s: 康维尔B-36“和平缔造者”是康维尔公司制造的活塞式战略轰炸机，1948年至1959年间由美国空军战略空军司令部使用。B-36共生产384架，至今仍是量产数量最多的活塞式飞机，翼展也是所有作战飞机中最大的。B-36无需空中加油即可进行洲际飞行，由六台普惠R-4360“黄蜂少校”星形活塞发动机提供动力。

en.s: The Marcinelle mining disaster (French: Catastrophe de Marcinelle, lit. 'the Marcinelle catastrophe') occurred at the Bois du Cazier coal mine at Marcinelle, Hainaut Province, in Belgium on 8 August 1956. One of the largest and most notorious mining disasters in the country's history, it led to the deaths of 262 miners, many of whom were guest workers from Italy. On the morning of 8 August 1956, an accident occurred underground as a result of the attempt to use the hoist mechanism before a coal wagon had been correctly loaded into the lift.

zh.s: 马尔西内勒矿难（法语：Catastrophe de Marcinelle，意为“马尔西内勒灾难”）于1956年8月8日发生在比利时埃诺省马尔西内勒的布瓦迪卡济耶煤矿。这是比利时历史上规模最大、最为人熟知的矿难之一，共有262名矿工遇难，其中许多人是来自意大利的外籍劳工。1956年8月8日上午，井下发生事故：在煤车尚未正确装入升降机前，操作人员就尝试启动提升装置。

en.s: The Battle of Las Mercedes (29 July – 8 August 1958) was the last battle which occurred during the course of Operation Verano, the summer offensive of 1958 launched by the Batista military dictatorship during the Cuban Revolution against the nationalist independence Cuban rebels of the 26th of July Movement. The battle was a trap, designed by Cuban General Eulogio Cantillo to lure Fidel Castro's guerrillas into a place where they could be surrounded and destroyed.

zh.s: 拉斯梅赛德斯战役于1958年7月29日至8月8日进行，是古巴革命期间“夏季行动”中的最后一场战斗。“夏季行动”是巴蒂斯塔军事独裁政权于1958年发动的夏季攻势，目标是打击争取民族独立的古巴七二六运动叛军。坎蒂略将军设计了一个圈套，诱使菲德尔·卡斯特罗的游击队进入包围圈，以便将其歼灭。

en.t: The Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU), the current ruling party of Zimbabwe, is formed by a split from the Zimbabwe African People's Union
en.s: The Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU) was a militant socialist organisation that fought against white-minority rule in Rhodesia, formed as a split from the Zimbabwe African People's Union (ZAPU) in 1963. ZANU split in 1975 into wings loyal to Robert Mugabe and Ndabaningi Sithole, later respectively called ZANU–PF and ZANU–Ndonga. These two sub-divisions ran separately at the 1980 general election, where ZANU–PF has been in power ever since, and ZANU–Ndonga a minor opposition party.

zh.t: 津巴布韦非洲民族联盟（ZANU）脱离津巴布韦非洲人民联盟后成立，现为津巴布韦执政党
zh.s: 津巴布韦非洲民族联盟（ZANU）是一个激进社会主义组织，1963年从津巴布韦非洲人民联盟（ZAPU）分裂出来，反抗罗得西亚白人少数统治。1975年，ZANU又分裂为分别效忠罗伯特·穆加贝和恩丹巴宁吉·西托尔的派系，后来分别称为ZANU—PF和ZANU—Ndonga。两个派系分别参加了1980年大选；此后ZANU—PF一直执政，ZANU—Ndonga则成为小型反对党。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Madagascar on 8 August 1965. They were won by the Social Democratic Party, which claimed 104 of the 107 seats (reduced from 127) in the National Assembly. Voter turnout was 94.43% of the 2,610,930 registered voters.

zh.s: 马达加斯加于1965年8月8日举行议会选举。社会民主党赢得选举，获得国民议会107席中的104席；本届议会席位由原来的127席缩减至107席。全国共有2,610,930名登记选民，投票率为94.43%。

en.s: The ASEAN Declaration, commonly known as the Bangkok Declaration, is the founding charter of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN). Signed on 8 August 1967 by the foreign ministers of Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand in Bangkok, the capital city of Thailand, it formally established the Association to promote regional cooperation in economic, social, cultural, technical, and administrative fields, and to foster regional peace and stability through adherence to the United Nations Charter and the rule of law.

zh.s: 东盟宣言又称《曼谷宣言》，是东南亚国家联盟（东盟）的创立文件。1967年8月8日，印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国的外交部长在泰国首都曼谷签署宣言，正式成立东盟，以促进经济、社会、文化、技术和行政领域的区域合作，并通过遵守《联合国宪章》和法治原则，维护地区和平与稳定。

en.t: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is founded by Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand
en.s: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN, ) is an intergovernmental forum of all 11 states in Southeast Asia. ASEAN primarily focuses on Southeast Asian economic development, peaceful coexistence and adherence to international norms. ASEAN operates on the principle of consensus and respecting national sovereignty, meaning that ASEAN as a whole cannot force another member state to change its domestic laws.

zh.t: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国共同创立东南亚国家联盟（东盟）
zh.s: 东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）是由东南亚全部11个国家组成的政府间论坛。东盟主要致力于东南亚经济发展、和平共处和遵守国际规范。东盟遵循协商一致和尊重国家主权的原则，这意味着东盟整体无权强迫任何成员国修改其国内法律。

en.s: This article lists those who were potential candidates for the Republican nomination for Vice President of the United States in the 1968 election. Whilst the first 80 years of Derby County F.C.'s existence had been relatively consistent, the era covered here saw the club experience five promotions and five relegations as it rose dramatically to its peak and back.

zh.t: 德比郡足球俱乐部历史（1967年至今）
zh.s: 德比郡足球俱乐部1967年至今的历史，涵盖布莱恩·克拉夫于1967年接掌俱乐部至2022—23赛季期间的重要事件。德比郡俱乐部成立后的前80年相对平稳，而本条目所述时期俱乐部经历了五次升级和五次降级，先是大幅攀升至巅峰，随后又跌落。

en.s: The 1970 FA Charity Shield was the 48th FA Charity Shield, the annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup competitions. It was contested between Everton, the reigning First Division champions, and Chelsea, holders of the FA Cup. Goals from Alan Whittle and Howard Kendall gave Everton a 2–1 victory; Chelsea's goal was scored by Ian Hutchinson.

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritania on 8 August 1971 to elect a President and National Assembly, the first time the two elections had been held together. At the time, the country was a one-party state with the Mauritanian People's Party (PPM) as the sole legal party. Its leader, incumbent President Moktar Ould Daddah, was the only candidate in the presidential election, and was re-elected unopposed, whilst the PPM won all 50 seats in the National Assembly election. Voter turnout for the parliamentary election was reported to be 95.6%.

zh.s: 毛里塔尼亚于1971年8月8日举行大选，选举总统和国民议会议员，这是两场选举首次同时举行。当时毛里塔尼亚是一党制国家，毛里塔尼亚人民党（PPM）是唯一合法政党。该党领袖、时任总统穆赫塔尔·乌尔德·达达赫是总统选举的唯一候选人，未经竞争即成功连任；PPM则赢得国民议会全部50个席位。议会选举投票率据报为95.6%。

en.s: In August 1975, the Banqiao Dam and 61 others throughout Henan, China, collapsed following the landfall of Typhoon Nina. The ensuing flood was among the deadliest floods in China and was the third-deadliest flood in history. It affected 12,000 km2 (3 million acres) with a total population of 10.15 million, including around 30 cities and counties, with estimates of the death toll ranging from 26,000 to 240,000.

zh.s: 1975年8月，妮娜台风登陆后，中国河南省板桥水库及其他61座水库相继溃坝。随后发生的洪灾是中国历史上伤亡最惨重的洪灾之一，也是历史上死亡人数第三多的洪水灾害。洪灾波及12,000平方公里（300万英亩），涉及人口总计1,015万，包括约30座城市和县；估计死亡人数从26,000到240,000不等。

en.s: The 1982 Corsican territorial elections were held on 8 August 1982, the first elections held for the nascent Corsican Assembly. They were held as the final step to establishing an autonomous government for the island of Corsica, as detailed in the Defferre accords. The elections were categorised as particularly disorganised, with many lists of candidates: 17 party lists with 61 candidates each, meaning 1,037 people ran for a seat in the assembly.

en.s: The 1983 Guatemalan coup d'état was a palace revolt in Guatemala by the officer corps, led by then Defense Minister General Óscar Humberto Mejía Víctores, which successfully ousted General Ríos Montt. Mejía Víctores governed the country for three years until international pressure forced him to make democratic reforms. By 1986, power was relinquished to the democratically elected Vinicio Cerezo.

zh.s: 1983年危地马拉政变是危地马拉军官团发动的一场宫廷政变，由时任国防部长奥斯卡·温贝托·梅希亚·维克托雷斯将军领导，成功推翻了里奥斯·蒙特将军。梅希亚·维克托雷斯执政三年，直到国际压力迫使他推行民主改革。到1986年，政权移交给民选总统比尼西奥·塞雷索。

en.s: The 8888 Uprising, also known as the 1988 Uprising, was a series of nationwide protests, marches, and riots in Burma (present-day Myanmar) that peaked in August 1988. Key events occurred on 8 August 1988 and therefore it is commonly known as the "8888 Uprising". The protests began as a student movement and were organised largely by university students at the Rangoon Arts and Sciences University and the Rangoon Institute of Technology.

en.s: STS-28 was the 30th NASA Space Shuttle mission, the fourth shuttle mission dedicated to United States Department of Defense (DoD) purposes, and the eighth flight of Space Shuttle Columbia. The mission launched on August 8, 1989, and traveled 3,400,000 km (2,100,000 mi) during 81 orbits of the Earth, before landing on runway 17 of Edwards Air Force Base, California, on August 13, 1989.

en.s: The Battle of Firebase Anaconda(not to be confused with Operation Anaconda) was a military engagement that took place on August 8, 2007. A group of roughly 75 Afghan militants mounted a rare frontal assault on a United States' Firebase Anaconda, but were repulsed with approximately 20 fatalities. No Americans were killed. The attack was rare in that instead of using asymmetric warfare tactics such as launching mortars at the base and quickly retreating, the Taliban forces' staged a direct assault on U.S.-led forces.

zh.s: 蟒蛇前哨基地战斗（不要与“蟒蛇行动”混淆）于2007年8月8日发生。一支约75人的阿富汗武装分子队伍罕见地正面进攻美国的蟒蛇前哨基地，但被击退，约20人死亡，美军无人阵亡。这次袭击不同寻常之处在于，塔利班没有采取向基地发射迫击炮后迅速撤退等非对称战术，而是直接向美军领导的部队发动进攻。

en.s: STS-118 was a Space Shuttle mission to the International Space Station (ISS) flown by the orbiter Endeavour. STS-118 lifted off on August 8, 2007, from launch pad 39A at Kennedy Space Center (KSC), Florida and landed at the Shuttle Landing Facility at KSC on August 21, 2007. This was the first flight of Endeavour since STS-113 in November 2002, which was also the last successful shuttle flight before STS-107, which culminated in the loss of Columbia when it disintegrated during reentry.

zh.s: STS-118是一次飞往国际空间站的航天飞机任务，由奋进号轨道飞行器执行。航天飞机于2007年8月8日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39A发射台升空，并于8月21日在该中心的航天飞机着陆场降落。这是奋进号自2002年11月STS-113任务以来首次飞行；STS-113也是STS-107任务之前最后一次成功的航天飞机飞行。STS-107最终导致哥伦比亚号在再入大气层时解体并损毁。

en.s: On 8 August 2008, at approximately 10:30 local time (8:30 UTC), EuroCity train EC 108 Comenius, en route from Kraków, Poland, to Prague, Czech Republic, struck a part of a motorway bridge that had fallen onto the railroad track near the Studénka railway station in the Czech Republic. zh.s: 2008年8月8日当地时间约10时30分（UTC 8时30分），从波兰克拉科夫开往捷克布拉格的欧洲城际列车EC 108“科梅纽斯号”撞上坠落在铁轨上的部分公路桥梁。事故发生在捷克斯图登卡火车站附近。列车脱轨，造成8人死亡、64人受伤。

en.s: UFC 101: Declaration was a mixed martial arts pay-per-view event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) on August 8, 2009 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It was the first ever UFC event held in Philadelphia. The event featured the second title defense of Lightweight Champion BJ Penn against Kenny Florian, and a non-title Light Heavyweight bout for Middleweight Champion Anderson Silva against former Light Heavyweight Champion Forrest Griffin.

en.s: Local elections were held in Sri Lanka on 8 August 2009 for two local councils in the north of the country: Jaffna Municipal Council and Vavuniya Urban Council. They were the first elections held in the country since the government declared victory in the 26-year-old civil war on 18 May 2009. They were also the first local elections held in the Northern Province in more than 11 years.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2009年8月8日为北部的两个地方议会举行选举，分别是贾夫纳市政委员会和瓦武尼亚市议会。政府于2009年5月18日宣布赢得长达26年的内战，此后这是全国举行的首场选举。这也是北部省11年多来首次举行地方选举。

en.s: The 2009 Supercoppa Italiana was a match played by the 2008–09 Serie A winners Inter Milan and 2008–09 Coppa Italia winners Lazio. It took place on 8 August 2009 at the Beijing National Stadium in Beijing, China. Lazio won the match 2–1 to earn their third Supercoppa title. This edition was the first time the Supercoppa Italiana was held in China, with China becoming the fourth country to host the competition.

zh.s: 2009年意大利超级杯由2008–09赛季意甲冠军国际米兰对阵意大利杯冠军拉齐奥。比赛于2009年8月8日在中国北京的国家体育场举行。拉齐奥以2比1获胜，第三次夺得意大利超级杯冠军。这是意大利超级杯首次在中国举行，中国也成为第四个承办该项赛事的国家。

en.s: Hardcore Justice (2010) (stylized HardCORE Justice, and occasionally referred to as Hardcore Justice: The Last Stand) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on August 8, 2010 at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the sixth event under the Hard Justice chronology and the eighth event of the 2010 TNA pay-per-view schedule.

en.s: The 2010 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield sponsored by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 88th FA Community Shield, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup competitions. A rematch of the previous year's FA Community Shield, the match was played at Wembley Stadium, London, on 8 August 2010, and contested by league and cup double winners Chelsea and league runners-up Manchester United.

zh.s: 2010年英格兰社区盾是第88届社区盾赛事，由上赛季英超和足总杯冠军参加。这场比赛是上一年社区盾的重赛，于2010年8月8日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由联赛和足总杯双冠王切尔西对阵联赛亚军曼联。因赞助关系，赛事也称为“麦当劳赞助的英格兰足总社区盾”。

en.s: The 2010 North African Super Cup was the first edition of the competition initiated by the North African Football Union (UNAF), an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's North African Cup and North African Cup Winners Cup competitions. The match was contested by 2009 North African Cup of Champions winners, ES Sétif, and 2009 North African Cup Winners Cup Champions, CS Sfaxien at the Stade 8 Mai 1945 in Sétif on 8 August 2010.

en.s: The 2012 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup final was played on August 8, 2012 at Livestrong Sporting Park, now known as Children's Mercy Park, in Kansas City, Kansas. The match was the culmination of the 2012 U.S. Open Cup, a tournament open to amateur and professional soccer teams affiliated with the United States Soccer Federation. This was the 99th edition of the oldest ongoing competition in American soccer.

zh.s: 2012年拉马尔·亨特美国公开杯决赛于2012年8月8日在堪萨斯州堪萨斯城的莱夫斯特朗体育公园举行，该场馆现称儿童慈善医院公园。决赛是2012年美国公开杯的收官赛事；这项赛事向所有隶属美国足球联合会的业余和职业足球队开放。这是美国足球历史最悠久、至今仍持续举办的赛事的第99届。

en.s: The 2012 Copa Argentina Final was the 185th and final match of the 2011–12 Copa Argentina, the first edition of the national cup relaunched by AFA in 2011. It was played in single match between Boca Juniors and Racing Club, on August 8, 2012 at the Estadio San Juan del Bicentenario. The winner qualified to play the 2012 Copa Sudamericana.

zh.s: 2012年阿根廷杯决赛是2011–12赛季阿根廷杯的第185场、也是最后一场比赛。这是阿根廷足球协会于2011年重新启动的全国杯赛的首届赛事。决赛于2012年8月8日举行，由博卡青年对阵竞赛俱乐部，双方只进行一场比赛，地点为圣胡安百年纪念体育场。胜者将获得参加2012年南美杯的资格。

en.s: On 8 August 2013, a suicide attacker exploded a bomb at a funeral being held for a police officer in Quetta, Pakistan, and killed as many as thirty-seven people and injured over fifty people. No group has taken responsibility for the bombing, but it is believed that the Taliban were behind the bombing. A senior police officer, Fayyaz Sumbal, noticed the suicide bomber before he blew himself up. As Fayyaz began searching the suicide bomber's body, the bomber blew himself up. The bomber was wearing a jacket that had ball bearings and shrapnel inside.

zh.s: 2013年8月8日，一名自杀式袭击者在巴基斯坦奎达一名警察的葬礼上引爆炸弹，造成最多37人死亡、50多人受伤。没有组织声称对此次爆炸负责，但据信是塔利班所为。高级警官费亚兹·松巴尔在袭击者引爆炸弹前发现了他。费亚兹开始搜查袭击者的身体时，炸弹被引爆。袭击者身穿的炸弹背心内装有滚珠轴承和弹片。

en.s: On August 8, 2015, a mass shooting occurred inside a home in northern Harris County, Texas, near Houston. David Ray Conley III, 48, broke into his former home and held hostage Valerie and Dwayne Jackson, Sr., along with six children, including his own 13-year-old son. Over the course of nine hours, he shot and killed the entire family. He then engaged in a shootout with responding police before surrendering.

zh.s: 2015年8月8日，得克萨斯州哈里斯县北部、休斯敦附近的一处住宅内发生大规模枪击案。48岁的戴维·雷·康利三世闯入自己以前居住的房子，劫持了瓦莱丽·杰克逊、德韦恩·杰克逊老先生及六名儿童为人质，其中包括他13岁的儿子。九个小时后，他枪杀了全家人，随后与赶到现场的警方交火，最终投降。

en.s: The 2015 Supercoppa Italiana was the 28th edition of the Supercoppa Italiana. It was played on 8 August 2015 at the Shanghai Stadium in Shanghai, China. With Juventus winning both the 2014–15 Serie A championship and the 2014–15 Coppa Italia, the game was played between Juventus and the 2014–15 Coppa Italia runners-up, Lazio. Juventus won the game 2–0 for their record seventh title.

zh.s: 2015年意大利超级杯是第28届赛事，于2015年8月8日在中国上海的上海体育场举行。由于尤文图斯包揽2014–15赛季意甲和意大利杯冠军，参赛双方为尤文图斯和意大利杯亚军拉齐奥。尤文图斯以2比0获胜，创纪录地第七次夺得超级杯冠军。

en.s: On 8 August 2016, terrorists attacked the Government Hospital of Quetta in Pakistan with a suicide bombing and shooting. They killed 70 and injured more than 130 others. The fatalities were mainly advocates (lawyers) who had assembled at the hospital where the body of Advocate Bilal Anwar Kasi, the president of Balochistan Bar Association, was brought after he was shot dead by an unknown gunman. Responsibility for the attack has been claimed by various Islamist groups like Jamaat-ul-Ahrar and the Islamic State. Between 70 and 94 people were killed and over 120 injured. 54 of those killed were lawyers.

zh.s: 2016年8月8日，恐怖分子在巴基斯坦奎达政府医院发动自杀式爆炸袭击和枪击，造成70人死亡、130多人受伤。死者主要是律师，他们聚集到医院悼念俾路支省律师协会主席比拉尔·安瓦尔·卡西律师；他此前被身份不明的枪手射杀，遗体被送到医院。多个伊斯兰主义组织声称对此负责，包括“自由战士团”和伊斯兰国。另有资料称，死亡人数为70至94人，受伤人数超过120人；死者中有54名律师。

zh.s: 2016年沙特超级杯是第四届赛事。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季沙特职业联赛和国王杯冠军参加。比赛于2016年8月8日举行，由2015–16赛季沙特职业联赛及2016年国王杯双料冠军吉达国民对阵2015–16赛季王储杯冠军利雅得新月。

en.s: The 2016 Egypt Cup final decided the winner of the 2016 Egypt Cup, the 84th season of Egypt's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 8 August 2016 at Borg El Arab Stadium in Alexandria. Zamalek, who have won the three previous finals, faced Al Ahly, the record-title holders who last won in 2007. Zamalek won the match 3–1 to secure their 4th consecutive and 25th overall title.

zh.s: 2016年埃及杯决赛决出了第84届埃及顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的冠军。比赛于2016年8月8日在亚历山大的博格阿拉伯体育场举行。扎马雷克此前连续赢得了三届决赛，本场对阵纪录夺冠次数最多、上一次于2007年夺冠的开罗国民。扎马雷克以3比1获胜，连续第四次、总计第25次夺得冠军。

en.s: General elections were held in Kenya on 8 August 2017 to elect the President, members of the National Assembly and Senate. They coincided with the 2017 Kenyan local elections which elected Governors and representatives in the devolved governments. The published results showed that incumbent President Uhuru Kenyatta of the Jubilee Party had been re-elected with 54% of the vote.

en.s: The 2017 UEFA Super Cup was the 42nd edition of the UEFA Super Cup, an annual football match organised by UEFA and contested by the reigning champions of the two main European club competitions, the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League. The match featured Spanish side Real Madrid, the title holders and winners of the 2016–17 UEFA Champions League, and English side Manchester United, the winners of the 2016–17 UEFA Europa League. The match was played at the Philip II Arena in Skopje, FYR Macedonia, on 8 August 2017, and was the first UEFA final staged in the country.

zh.s: 2017年欧洲超级杯是第42届赛事，由欧洲足球协会联盟（UEFA）主办。这项年度赛事由欧洲两大俱乐部赛事——欧洲冠军联赛和欧洲联赛——的卫冕冠军参加。参赛双方为西班牙球队皇家马德里（2016–17赛季欧洲冠军联赛冠军）和英格兰球队曼联（2016–17赛季欧洲联赛冠军）。比赛于2017年8月8日在前南斯拉夫马其顿共和国首都斯科普里的菲利普二世竞技场举行，这是该国首次举办欧足联决赛。

en.s: The 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquake occurred on 8 August 2017, in Zhangzha Town, Jiuzhaigou County, Ngawa Prefecture, Sichuan Province, China. The earthquake was registered at Ms 7.0 and killed 29 people in the mountainous region of northern Sichuan.

en.s: The 2018 Suruga Bank Championship (Japanese: スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2018; Spanish: Copa Suruga Bank 2018) was the eleventh edition of the Suruga Bank Championship (also referred to as the J.League Cup / Copa Sudamericana Championship Final), the club football match co-organized by the Japan Football Association, the football governing body of Japan, CONMEBOL, the football governing body of South America, and J.League, the professional football league of Japan, between the champions of the previous season's J.League Cup and Copa Sudamericana. The match was contested between Japanese team Cerezo Osaka, the 2017 J.League Cup champions, and Argentinian team Independiente, the 2017 Copa Sudamericana champions. It was hosted by Cerezo Osaka at the Yanmar Stadium Nagai in Osaka, Japan on 8 August 2018.

en.s: The jihadist organisation Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) has imposed a complete blockade upon the city of Timbuktu, Mali since 8 August 2023. en.s: On August 8, 2024, a convoy of Burkinabe army vehicles headed to Fada N'Gourma from Diapaga were ambushed by militants from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM), killing between 150 and 200 Burkinabe soldiers and militiamen. While the Burkinabe junta has not released a statement confirming the death toll, the attack marks the deadliest incident against Burkinabe soldiers since the start of the jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso.

en.t: Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus takes oath as Chief Adviser to form an interim government in Bangladesh
en.s: Muhammad Yunus (Bengali: মুহাম্মদ ইউনূস; born 28 June 1940) is a Bangladeshi economist and statesman. Yunus pioneered the modern concept of microcredit and microfinance, for which he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2006. He is the founder of Grameen Bank and the first Bangladeshi to win the Nobel Peace Prize. Following the July Uprising, he was appointed as the 5th chief adviser of Bangladesh, the head of the interim government, serving from 2024 to 2026.

zh.t: 诺贝尔奖得主穆罕默德·尤努斯宣誓就任首席顾问，组建孟加拉国临时政府
zh.s: 穆罕默德·尤努斯（孟加拉语：মুহাম্মদ ইউনূস；生于1940年6月28日）是孟加拉国经济学家和政治家。他开创了现代小额信贷和微型金融理念，并于2006年因此获得诺贝尔和平奖。他创办了格莱珉银行，是首位获得诺贝尔和平奖的孟加拉国人。七月起义后，他获任孟加拉国第五任首席顾问，领导临时政府，任期为2024年至2026年。
